scenario.label_zh: 确认雨天课程移至室内
scenario.goal_zh: 确认课程没有取消及室内场地，商定见面地点并避免不必要的赶路

context_zh: 克洛伊准备去公园上瑜伽课，朋友来电转告教练通知。
author: author-phase05-c

sentences.speaker: Chloe
sentences.text: It has started raining. Has the class been cancelled?

sentences.speaker: Jamal
sentences.text: No, the coach has arranged an indoor session in the studio beside the park.

sentences.speaker: Chloe
sentences.text: Good. I would rather exercise indoors today anyway.

sentences.speaker: Jamal
sentences.text: It still starts at six. Where are you now?

sentences.speaker: Chloe
sentences.text: At the bus stop. Do I need to hurry?

sentences.speaker: Jamal
sentences.text: No, you have twenty minutes. I will wait by the studio entrance, not the park gate.

sentences.speaker: Chloe
sentences.text: Thanks. I will meet you at the studio at ten to six.
